chapter: Young Tuxedo and Chris Kelly years
title: Blue's real surname and his son
summary: Allen and Bailey sort out whether Blue's name was Donison or Robertson and talk about his son.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Donison. His son told me his name was Blue Robertson. Blue Robertson? The little blue calls himself Blue Robertson. You know a…
He hung up with that one son of a day. He's a little son of a day.
He used to drink. He was brought up by I think Eddie Marrero or Simon or John. One of those brothers you know. Marrero, Moran they call him.
I don't know if he drinks. He used to drink. He drinks. He still drinks. I haven't seen him in quite a while.
